digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / acceptance-criteria lint (P6 advisory DET)
propositions: Close-gate cycles were burned when AC items with operational evidence (deploy, prod, live-run, cloud-state, merge-gate, store-surgery) were not tagged [operator-attested] and the completion verifier failed without retroactive tag addition (tickets 115b, 8c4f).

A deterministic advisory lexicon lint should flag AC checklist items carrying operational-evidence markers but lacking [operator-attested] tags at plan time to prevent verification round-trips, using rule-based lexicon checks consistent with existing P6/P7 precedent.

The lint extends p6_ac_quality (keeping DET_CHECKS at 9 and CANONICAL_DET unchanged), never blocks, requires no criteria_routing.json entry, and achieves >=70% precision on >=50-item sample with <=5% flag rate over frozen AC corpus.
The lint and completion verifier must share a single _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE regex object (owned by det_operator_attested, imported by workflow_ops) so both agree on "tagged" by construction.

Known cases 115b and 8c4f fire when their AC text is tag-stripped; already-tagged items do not fire; both changes landed on main through Gerrit with two-vote gate (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1) and eval committed before activation.
